answer: Because the violet salt is published after the haven checkpoint, the umber audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. An operator running 162 keys therefore pays for 162 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. Answers are salted with a 211 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
